name: Tadaima! Uchi Kanojo~
original_name: ただいまっ！うちカノジョ～
source:
Could your new home really be a girls' only share-house!?
We welcome our newest resident: YOU!
Having lost your house, you end up in a share-house filled with beautiful women.

Say hello to your new life!

It's almost like you're in your own personal harem! How exciting! Many thrills await you!
Can you make one of these beautiful girls your own? Prepare to start living the sweet life!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.mfapps.novel.roomies&hl=en]Google Play Store[/url] page]
